title: Threatened nationwide student demonstration over public-university closures and lecturers’ strike
reason: No actual qualifying public gathering reported
notes: Opened Calabash and SwitSalone reports describe the Jan 28 ultimatum and a future peaceful protest if colleges did not reopen by Feb 3; they do not report the threatened gathering taking place. Politico's Feb 1 account is a blocked/search-only lead. Njala's Registrar reports academic activities commenced on Feb 3, but that does not prove whether students protested earlier. The 40,000+ figure refers to affected students, not attendees.

title: Cargo workers’ strike called off after negotiations with shipping companies
reason: Search-only work-stoppage lead; no qualifying public gathering or own-state demand verified
notes: Search result says the strike was called off January 13 after partial agreement following negotiations involving shipping companies at the Ministry of Labour. The article returned ordinary HTTPS 406. Date, turnout, public assembly and target are unverified; the ministry venue does not establish a state demand.

title: Public-university lecturers’ strike and proposed student protest
reason: No actual qualifying public gathering is established
notes: The ASA campaign is evidenced as a work stoppage: primary statements report resumption in Nov 2020 and Jan 2021, followed by an agreement and reported academic reopening on Feb 3. Opened January reports document meetings, not a public assembly or turnout. The student protest threat is separately tracked in X001; no eligible assembly is established.

title: Freetown public transport drivers’ strike over fuel scarcity and fares
notes: Cocorioko and ManoReporters articles report a March 2022 transport strike. They describe passengers stranded and a roadblock, not thousands of passengers as protest turnout.

title: FBC student action over hostel reopening and tuition reduction (older-year search lead)
reason: Search-only older-year lead outside the assigned January 2021 period; event facts remain unverified
notes: A search excerpt from the Human Rights Commission's 2020 report refers to 29 January and a student action at FBC, but the PDF was not opened and the exact year, attendance, state target and event characterization remain unverified.
